text: There's a tuft of wool stuffed in my bedroom keyhole.
It's been there for six years.
My gran said the mare comes in through keyholes.
She's the weight on your chest when you wake up and can't move.
Block the hole while she's inside... and she can't leave.
Six years ago, she came every night.
So one night, I stuffed the keyhole shut.
It stopped. That same week, I met my wife.
Tonight, she asked what the wool was for.
So I pulled it out to show her.
Something was climbing onto my chest.
I tried to reach for my wife.
Her side of the bed was empty. Still warm.
I never got rid of the mare.
Long hair fell across my face.
